title: Move to specific workout type
body:
Knowing that the Galaxy watch does not have implicit badminton sports type for choosing, and instead we can only use “Other workout”.....

Would be good if this app allow us recategorising the recorded “Other workout” back to badminton (or any other types where applicable). I believe that is simple from programming perspective but It helps improve the user experience a lot !

Even better if the watch allows us choosing this specific badminton workout type but I think it is out of the control from the application developer.

Please consider and I think it benefits a lot of users by this simple change!

title: Poor Connections
body:
The Samsung Health App especially for the iOS is unable to stand on its own. Sure it has sleep tracking and records your fitness, but it doesn’t do it well. 

The main drawback is it’s inability to integrate with Strava and doesn’t provide any of the in-depth analysis that any fitness tracking should and does provide. 

More importantly, this is complete contrast to what the site promised and watch promised. 

Overall, really disappointed with the fake marketing and the lack of capabilities and integrations with other apps.
